..Responde
 __________
 Mr. Rashid Khan i/b. Tasneem Zaidy, for the Petitioner.
 Ms. Sheetal Malvankar, Agp for the State.
 Mr. P. G. Lad, for Mhada.

_
 Coram: G. S. Kulk
 Aarti Sath
 Date: 06 October
 P.C.
1.

We are informed by Mr. Lad, learned Counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 that the compensation which would be entitled to the petitioner, has been deposited with respondent No.4-Special Land Acquisition Officer.
We permit the petitioner to make an application to withdraw the amount of compensation which be disbursed in favour of the petitioner in accordance with law alongwith the accrued interest.
Let formalities in that regard be completed on or before the adjourned date fo hearing.
